definition.name: hull-relaxation
definition.question: Why can a relaxation yield a strictly better objective while the exact hull does not?
definition.formula: integer points S={(0,0),(1,0),(0,1)}; left conv(S); right P=[0,1]^2 intersect {x1+x2<=1.5}; maximize x1+x2
definition.sampling: Exact polygon vertices and three integer points. Right highlighted fractional maximizer=(.75,.75).
definition.design: Identical axis limits and equal aspect; optimal faces coral; feasible polygons same shallow fill. Fractional square marker contrasts integer circles.
